title: Data Storytelling
objectives: Explain the key ideas behind Data Storytelling.
Describe why Data Storytelling matters in Data Analytics.
Apply Data Storytelling to a realistic scenario.
Identify common pitfalls and how to avoid them.
Answer interview questions about Data Storytelling.
definition: Data Storytelling is a core concept in Data Analytics. It refers to the techniques, principles and practices that let a practitioner work effectively with this topic in real systems.

theory.heading: What Data Storytelling is
theory.body: Data Storytelling describes the methods and patterns used within Data Analytics to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: Data Storytelling is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why Data Storytelling matters
theory.body: Without Data Storytelling, systems built with Data Analytics are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Data Storytelling works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Data Storytelling follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of Data Storytelling.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Data Storytelling
theory.body: Data Storytelling offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.

interview.question: What is Data Storytelling?
interview.answer: Data Storytelling is a core concept in Data Analytics that describes the techniques used to work effectively with this area.
interview.explanation: Give a concise, accurate definition and one example.

interview.question: Why is Data Storytelling important?
interview.answer: It improves reliability, maintainability and clarity in Data Analytics systems.

interview.question: What are the limitations of Data Storytelling?
interview.answer: It adds overhead and may be unnecessary for simple cases; apply it judiciously.

interview.question: How would you explain Data Storytelling to a junior teammate?
interview.answer: Start with the definition, show a small example, then walk through a realistic use case and its trade-offs.
interview.explanation: Structure the explanation from simple to applied.
